name: teams-tasks
description: Reads your recent Microsoft Teams conversations, works out what you need to do, and keeps those tasks in a panel beside the chat.

scanEveryMinutes.title: Scan every (minutes)
scanEveryMinutes.description: How often Teams is checked for new tasks while a session is open. 0 checks only when you run /teams-tasks scan.

lookbackDays.title: First scan looks back (days)
lookbackDays.description: How many days of Teams messages the first scan reads. Later scans read from the last scan on.

model.title: Scan model
model.description: The model that reads the conversations. inherit uses the session's own model.

myName.title: Your name in Teams
myName.description: Optional. Helps tell requests aimed at you from requests aimed at others in group chats.

tools.title: Teams tools
tools.description: Optional. Exact names of the read-only Teams tools to use, separated by commas (mcp__server__tool). Empty finds them by itself.

openOnNewTasks.title: Open the panel on new tasks
openOnNewTasks.description: Opens the Teams tasks panel when a scan finds something new.
